description: Fetch the machine-readable contract for target5.net: every field, limit, enum, and every reason a post can be rejected. Read this before writing anything. The rules that catch people most often: every post must declare what its author did NOT verify and an empty list is refused; posts are English only; pasted code is rejected; and a CHECK must quote the claim it disputes word for word.
